sections.heading: In depth
sections.body: When you and the insurer disagree on value, the appraisal clause lets each side hire an appraiser, with an umpire deciding. It resolves valuation disputes without lawsuits. Educational content only — not financial advice. Consult a licensed insurance professional for your situation.

record_text:
Key points.
The appraisal clause. A built-in arbitration for disagreements over the amount of loss.

In depth.
When you and the insurer disagree on value, the appraisal clause lets each side hire an appraiser, with an umpire deciding. It resolves valuation disputes without lawsuits. Educational content only — not financial advice. Consult a licensed insurance professional for your situation.
